The video segment opens with a black screen with the text “Katheryn Winnick” in gold lettering. Transitioning to an opening scene, a man, dressed in a dark suit with a blue and white striped tie, stands on a stage with red curtains behind him and a faux cityscape visible through a glass door behind him. He gestures to his left as he introduces Katheryn Winnick, whose name is superimposed in gold lettering. Above the name is the text “13th March 2014,” also in gold lettering. A blonde woman, Katheryn Winnick, dressed in a light-colored, form-fitting dress with a black belt, enters from a door to the right. She smiles and waves, greets the man with a kiss on the cheek, and shakes his hand. He playfully points to her, then they walk towards a set featuring two chairs and a desk, situated in front of a large window with a cityscape view. The scene cuts to a skeleton prop dressed in a suit coat and tie. The skeleton has glowing blue lights in its eye sockets, and a tag labeled "GEOFF". The scene then cuts back to Katheryn Winnick, sitting in one of the chairs as the man stands behind the desk. The man compliments Winnick on her appearance, gesturing towards her in a conversational manner. She smiles, touches her hair, and gestures in response, engaging in a dialogue with the man. She then touches one of her earrings and comments that it is different from the Vikings jewelry. Both laugh.

The scene shows a late-night talk show setting with a male host in a dark suit and tie engaging in conversation with a female guest in a light-colored dress with a black belt. The woman is seated in an armchair with her legs crossed, laughing and gesturing with her hand near her face. The man sits behind a wooden desk, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. On the desk are a decorative ceramic snake teapot, a disco ball, and a CBS logo. A blue mug with text is visible near the armchair. The background features a large window revealing a cityscape at night, with various buildings illuminated. The camera angle remains static, focusing on the two individuals as they converse, with no apparent visual changes or transitions during this segment.

The clip shows a scene from "The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson," featuring Craig Ferguson, in a dark suit and tie, talking with Katheryn Winnick, in a light grey one-shoulder dress with a black belt. Winnick demonstrates a blocking gesture with an arm raised to Ferguson, who in turn expresses mock fear and amusement. Winnick shares that she started training in martial arts at age seven, got her first black belt at 13, and started her first school at 16. Ferguson inquires if her kick-ass abilities intimidate men or attract them. Winnick is amused, while Ferguson emphasizes that he finds it "strangely intimidating." The studio set features a desk with a decorative mug, behind which Ferguson sits, and Winnick is seated in a tan armchair next to the desk. The background shows a nighttime cityscape view through the set's window. The CBS logo is visible at the lower right of the screen.

To his left sits a blonde woman, dressed in a short white dress with a black belt, in a beige chair. They are engaging in conversation, with the man making hand gestures and the woman smiling. As the conversation progresses, the man retrieves a trombone and harmonica from under the desk. He pretends to play the trombone while she plays the harmonica. The segment concludes with an outro featuring the man and a group of people dancing on the set, overlaid with the text "Outro" and a final message "Have A Great Day!" The setting is a television studio with a backdrop showing a nighttime city scene. Other objects in the scene include a CBS logo on the desk, a mug, and a decorative snake sculpture. Visual changes include the introduction of the musical instruments and the transition to the dancing outro scene. In the middle of the segment, the words "The End Outro Coming..." flash briefly across the screen.
